summary: Tested reverse geocoding feature for GPS capture. Backend: 10/10 tests passed - reverse-geocode endpoint returns proper address, locality, area, city for Mumbai/Delhi/Bangalore coordinates. Frontend: Address column present in MyAttendance.js table, QuickCheckInModal.js calls /api/reverse-geocode to convert GPS coordinates to address. Existing attendance records show '-' for Address because they were created before the feature was implemented.
